state.note: Feature title 'Config: Strategy Defaults'. Keyword prefix is 'Feature:'. After stripping, title text is 'Config: Strategy Defaults'. Colons in title text are part of the title per domain_spec.md line 253. Word count: 'Config:' and 'Strategy' and 'Defaults' = 3 words (colon attached to 'Config:' but split on whitespace gives 3 tokens: 'Config:', 'Strategy', 'Defaults'). Actually: splitting on whitespace → ['Config:', 'Strategy', 'Defaults'] → 3 words. Colon is NOT in [\w\s]+ charset: ':' is punctuation.

stimulus.contract: Feature Parsing validates keywords: strips Gherkin prefix, colons in text are part of the title. Charset: [\w\s]+
